testCase.name: [本地] S14 Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D6 · P1 · Daniela

转录 / 保留时长和 UAT 3.6 不一致：归档 48 小时（不是 36）、养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）、「Earlier sessions」和「Most Recent」不带日期、快速口述框永不过期、保留时长写死在代码里（是不是要做成配置）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-16/S10, TC-16/S11, TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S14 「按服务器时钟人工老化走查：医院第 1 天 → 第 2 天 → 第 3 天，用真实录音；养老院第 1 → 4 次就诊，相隔几周」 Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U6a Hospital, the part of 'today and yesterday only' that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12: on server day D, no bedside recording from D-4 or earlier is listed (archived as '(prior)' or left …（UAT 3.6；TFA-92594 AC 2；UAT TC-13 (day-2 reopen)）
  • U6b Hospital edges that depend on Q1 (calendar day vs hour windows: a D-2 or D-3 recording), Q10 (36 h vs 54 h in all for typed dictation: a row archived 35 h ago) and Q12 (prototype per-stay history vs …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-92594 AC 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U7 Nursing Home: transcripts are kept for the last two visits.（UAT 3.6；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. …（UAT 3.8）
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is.（TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Aging helper (server-clock offset) on the local stack and a browser whose clock follows it. Hospital patient: day 1 bedside recording and typed encounter notes; the physician reopens the chart on day 2 and day 3 (server days). Nursing Home resident seen on four visits a week apart, each with dictated visit text

When Hospital: on day 2 record again and open the panel; on day 3 open it without recording. Nursing Home: after each visit's 12 h window has passed, open the Encounter tab

Then Day 2: day 1 is listed on its own as yesterday, with the right date, and no archive button is tapped; the typed day-1 note is gone from the working box and listed (TC-13 day-2 reopen). Day 3: day 1 is gone and day 2 is listed as yesterday. Nursing Home: after V1: V1; after V2: V1, V2; after V3: V2, V3 only; after V4: V3, V4 only

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U1 (no manual step), U6a (day 2), U6b (day 3: calendar vs hours is Q1, prototype vs AC 2 is Q12; judged after those answers), U7 (the real walk; the count rule itself is seeded in S11), T2 (row date = the recording's day), U9 (server day; whose day is Q9). Everything that needs no server-day move is seeded in S10, S11, S17 and S18

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92594 ready for qa

住户第 3、4 次访视后，Encounter 页仍列出三次访视（V1–V3，然后 V2–V4），不是最近两次。

After a resident's third and fourth visits the Encounter tab still lists three visits (V1–V3, then V2–V4) instead of the last two.

依据：Allure 6678b490, manual TIME lane: 8 of 12 cells passed. The only failing cells are the NH U7 visit-count cells, with the same root as the dev result TC-16/S11 (SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3). The lane ties it to TFA-94699 (in progress). Recorded only, under Q1/Q12: on day 3 the day-1 '(prior)' recording is still listed because it has no archivedAt. The Hospital day 1→2 cells pass.

重复：和 TC-16/S11 是同一个问题，看那条（保留的）；这条带标签「重复」，筛选时可以去掉。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：manual。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S14

Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：chromium spec. Hospital: day 1 (page.clock = yesterday): the typed note goes in through the Encounter Notes box (autosave), then a bedside recording with the e2e speech stub; the day-1 page is closed. Day 2 (real clock): a new recording, then the Encounter tab. Day 3: chart aged 24 h, tab opened without recording (recorded: day-1/day-2 listing, archive stamps). On main a stopped recording starts Generate Note & Finish by itself, so ai/notes:generateNote is answered with a failure at the socket (no model call). Nursing Home: four visits a week apart, aged 7 days between visits, twice: visit text written by snf:update, and visit text typed in the Encounter tab box (the app's own autosave). Code-read cell: Nursing Home has no bedside recorder at e02167f. — The archive rule and the visit-count rule are server/stamp driven and checkable. The real microphone recording on a device (the 'real recordings' half) needs a person with a phone; day-3 calendar-vs-hours is Q1/Q12 (recorded).

Detail:

8/12 judged cells pass, 3 recorded. Fail: Encounter-tab visit text, after visit 3: the Encounter tab lists V2, V3 only [U7] | Encounter-tab visit text, after visit 4: the Encounter tab lists V3, V4 only [U7] | after visit 3: the Encounter tab lists V2, V3 only [U7] | after visit 4: the Encounter tab lists V3, V4 only [U7]. Recorded: day 3: day 1 gone and day 2 listed as yesterday (Q1 calendar vs hours, Q12) = {"prior":["Oct 12 · Encounter notes","Oct 12 (prior)"],"day1ListedAsPrior":true,"day2ListedAsPrior":false,"day1StillStored":true,"day2InWork | day 3: archive stamps on the prior entries (bedside '(prior)' rows carry no archivedAt, so the 48 h prune never removes them) = [{"label":"Oct 12 · Encounter notes","archivedAt":"2026-10-13T07:49:56.460Z"},{"label":"Oct 12 (prior)","archivedAt":null}] | code read: Nursing Home has a bedside recorder that writes '(prior)' transcript entries = {"recorderFilesInSrcFeaturesSnf":[],"convexSnfCallsApplyTranscriptArchive":false}.

产品问题：Ungated fail (TC-16 U7 has gate None), same root cause as TFA-94699 (Nursing Home last two visits; main SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3). After visit 3 the Encounter tab lists V1, V2 and V3, and after visit 4 it lists V2, V3 and V4; the UAT expects the last two (UAT 3.6, TFA-92594 AC 2). Same result whether the visit text is written by snf:update or typed in the Encounter tab box (the app's autosave). The Hospital day-1 → day-2 cells pass. Recorded, not judged (Q1/Q12): on day 3 the day-1 recording is still listed ('<date> (prior)' entries from the bedside path carry no archivedAt, so the 48 h prune in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts never removes them) and day 2 is not listed as prior (it stays the working transcript until the next recording).

跑的时候（runNote）：On main a stopped bedside recording (and a completed encounter dictation) starts Generate Note & Finish by itself (useGenerateAfterCapture). Earlier runs today let that Generate reach the model (forbidden locally); the specs now answer ai/notes:generateNote with a failure at the socket. In two local runs where the auto-Generate did run (15:58, 16:09 JST; the typed day-1 note was then written by rounding:update with the day-1 page still open), the typed day-1 note was gone from both the box and the prior list on day 2; with Generate withheld and the note typed in the box it is listed. Worth checking on dev, where Generate runs.

人工清单（manualChecklist）：

  • 【TC-16/S14 真麦克风那一半：Quinn 10-14 已把麦克风/扬声器口述放到一边，这一项暂不安排】
  • 如果以后要做：每天约 5 分钟、连续 2–3 天（不是一次 5 分钟），本地栈、Mac 上的 Chrome（不是商店/TestFlight 版）。
  • 第 1 天：开一个 QA 病人 → Encounter → Start bedside recording，说一句“QA16-DAY1 咳嗽好些了” → Stop；在 Encounter notes 里打一句 QA16-DAY1-TYPED。注意：main 上停止录音会自动开始 Generate Note & Finish。
  • 第 2 天：同一病人再录一句 → Stop → 看 Prior Encounter Transcripts：第 1 天录音单独一行、日期是第 1 天；第 1 天手打的那句已不在输入框、出现在列表里。
  • 第 3 天：只打开不录：记下第 1 天还在不在、第 2 天是不是作为“昨天”列出（Q1/Q12 未定，只记录）。
  • 自动化那一半（桌面浏览器 + 语音桩 + page.clock，Generate 在 socket 处拦下）已经跑过，本清单只补“真麦克风/真设备”这一点。

证据：附了 18 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper's server-clock offset and page.clock in the browser (the given puts it on the local stack); dev's server clock cannot be moved and dev has no admin key, so it stays a local-stack case (manual until the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
